displayName: PauseGuard: selftest or scheduled job failed

documentation.content: Either the daily `POST /admin/selftest` (Aisyah's GREEN scenario through Gemini) did not come out GREEN, or a Cloud Scheduler job (selftest, 6-hourly reset-demo) failed. The `selftest_failed` log line has the verdict and the reason. A Gemini slowdown shows as `AMBER + needs_review`: re-run with `gcloud scheduler jobs run pauseguard-selftest --location asia-southeast1`. Runbook: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md §7.

conditions.displayName: selftest_failed, or a Scheduler attempt ended in an error

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="__SERVICE__" AND jsonPayload.message="selftest_failed") OR (resource.type="cloud_scheduler_job" AND resource.labels.job_id=~"^pauseguard-" AND severity>=ERROR)
